The Integration Pitch

Why Vorro, Why Now

Wellvana's entire value proposition rests on Clarity turning fragmented clinical, financial, and social data from dozens of unrelated partner organizations into one real-time picture a care team can act on. That promise is only as fast as the weakest interface — and with Mercy's Epic instance, new CIN practices, and Cook County Health's environment all onboarding on different timelines, every new affiliation currently means another bespoke integration project before a single gap-in-care alert can fire.

The highest-leverage moment is now, while Wellvana is actively standing up its largest CIN yet with Mercy and simultaneously onboarding 190,000 more Medicare lives for 2026. Vorro's platform absorbs whatever EHR a new partner runs — Epic, Cerner, athenahealth, MEDITECH, or a smaller community system — and normalizes it into the FHIR, HL7, and C-CDA feeds Clarity already expects, collapsing months of per-partner interface work into a standard, repeatable connection.

For Dr. Rankey, that means the clinical and quality data behind MSSP and Medicare Advantage performance — HEDIS gaps, admissions, care coordination flags — arrives consistently no matter which health system or independent practice it came from, so his 15 years of scaled value-based care programs aren't bottlenecked by the next partner's IT timeline.
